name: TSC® Visa® Card
balance_transfer_apr: 32.74%, for balance transfers completed within 4 months of account opening
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.requirement: on your first qualifying purchase of $20 or more (limited-time offer terms rotate; confirm the live offer before applying)

verdict.text: Strong 5% for regular farm/ranch shoppers, still a specialty card

earn_note: This is the open-loop Visa version of Tractor Supply's card: it earns outside Tractor Supply, unlike the closed-loop, store-only TSC Store Card, which earns the same 5% at Tractor Supply but can be used only at Tractor Supply, TractorSupply.com and Petsense. Cardholders are automatically enrolled as Preferred Plus Neighbors, the highest tier of Tractor Supply's Neighbor's Club loyalty program. On Tractor Supply purchases of $199 and up you choose between the 5% reward and special financing, not both.

redemption_options.method: Redeemable at Tractor Supply stores, TractorSupply.com, or in the TSC App

points.per_100k: $1,000 in Tractor Supply rewards (5 points per $1 = 5%)
points.note: A closed-loop currency despite the open-loop Visa network: rewards come back as Tractor Supply credit, not cash or a statement credit.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Neighbor's Club Rewards redeem only at Tractor Supply.

insurance.detail: Not confirmed on Citi's or Tractor Supply's public product pages for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's or Tractor Supply's public product pages for this card

protection_note: No Guide to Benefits for this card is public, and Citi's product page lists no purchase protection, extended warranty, or travel insurance. Treat it as a rewards-and-financing card with no insurance you can count on.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

status_perks.name: Preferred Plus Neighbor status
status_perks.note: Cardholders are automatically placed in Neighbor's Club's highest membership tier, unlocking extra in-store perks and offers beyond the card's own rewards.

services.name: Special financing offers
services.detail: On Tractor Supply purchases of $199 and up you can choose special financing instead of the 5% reward. Purchases of $1,599 or more qualify for a 3.99% APR over 36 months with fixed monthly payments. Deferred-interest promotions charge all interest back to the purchase date if the balance isn't paid in full in time.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
No dedicated insurance to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed protection suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling a household's farm/ranch, pet-supply, and gas/grocery spend toward the bonus categories.

timeline.text: Tractor Supply/Citi issue two distinct card products: the closed-loop TSC Store Card (5% at Tractor Supply, usable only at Tractor Supply, TractorSupply.com and Petsense) and this open-loop TSC Visa Card (same 5%, plus 3% gas/grocery/vet and 1% elsewhere). Confirm which one you're comparing; they are not the same card.
